notes: Five linked competencies around headless software rendering. dependent_stages=3: icon -> C path tracer -> offscreen color+depth rasterizer -> OSMesa GL proof -> interpreter pointer, each a real deliverable re-executed by the verifier. tool_breadth=3: C with -lm, C with -losmesa (software GL), Python+numpy, and four raster formats (PFM color, P2 PGM depth, PPM, PNG). quantitative_correctness=3: the C tracer, the python color/depth rasterizer and the independent tests/reference.py must all agree within a tight tolerance on the documented lambert+ambient shading model on the default scene and on hidden scenes, via a genuinely independent golden generator in tests/. adversarial_inputs=3: hidden scenes exercise degenerate zero-radius spheres, giant radii that fill the viewport, clamped/out-of-range sizes, odd resolutions and malformed tokens; tools must stay robust. hidden_case_generalization=3: test.sh re-compiles /app/ptrace.c and re-runs both the tracer and the python rasterizer (through the recorded interpreter) on fresh hidden scenes the agent has never seen. debugging_ambiguity=2: wrong PFM/PGM/PPM layout or shading drops SSIM below threshold and is only diagnosed by re-rendering. The two hard-floor competencies (compact from-scratch C path tracer, and offscreen color/depth render matching a reference) set the difficulty sentinel.
